name: NABirds
description: Fine-grained bird classification dataset with 555 categories and about 48,000 images. It is distinct from CUB-200. Cornell Lab custom terms apply; no data is vendored in this repository.
citation: Van Horn, G., Branson, S., Farrell, R., et al. (2015). Building a bird recognition app and large scale dataset with citizen scientists: The fine print in fine-grained dataset collection. In Proceedings of the IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR). NABirds.

license.identifier: Cornell Lab custom terms; not a standard SPDX identifier
